get_property_from_atoms: get a property value from an ASE Atoms object by name from its properties or info dictionary
normalize_property_by_natoms: normalize a property value by dividing it by the number of atoms in an ASE Atoms object
normalize_property_by_other: normalize a property value by dividing it by another property value from an ASE Atoms object
get_property_dict_from_atoms: retrieve multiple properties from an ASE Atoms object and return them as a dictionary with optional normalization
get_normalized_property_dict: get a dictionary of properties from an ASE Atoms object with per-atom or per-property normalization applied
